title: GrafTech Announces Planned Closure of Monterrey Graphite Electrode Facility
summary: BROOKLYN HEIGHTS, Ohio, August 31, 2026--GrafTech International Ltd. (NYSE: EAF) today announced its decision to permanently close its graphite electrode manufacturing facility in Monterrey, Mexico. The Company plans to wind down operations at the Monterrey facility in phases, with production expected to conclude early in the second quarter of 2027.
